units.source_text: 源氏公子正要回去，

en.t: Prince Genji was just about to go back,

units.source_text: 忽又想道：如果走到正殿那边，

en.t: when suddenly he thought again: if he went over toward the main hall,

units.source_text: 也许可以窥察这小姐的情况，

en.t: perhaps he could catch a glimpse of how the young lady was doing,

units.source_text: 便偷偷地走过去。

en.t: so he quietly made his way over there.

units.source_text: 这里的篱笆大部分已经坍损，

en.t: Most of the fence here had already collapsed and fallen into ruin,

units.source_text: 只剩下一点点。

en.t: with only a small part left standing.

units.source_text: 他便走到篱笆遮隐的地方去。

en.t: He went to a place where the fence could conceal him.

units.source_text: 岂知早有一个男人站在那里。

en.t: But, unexpectedly, a man was already standing there.

units.source_text: 他想：“这是谁？

en.t: He thought, "Who is this?

units.source_text: 一定是追求这位小姐的一个色情儿了。”

en.t: He must be one of those amorous men pursuing this young lady."

units.source_text: 他便躲在月光照不到的暗处。

en.t: He then hid in a dark spot where the moonlight did not reach.

units.source_text: 这个人是头中将。

en.t: This man was To no Chujo.

units.source_text: 这一天傍晚，源氏公子和头中将一同从宫中退出。

en.t: That evening, Prince Genji and To no Chujo had left the palace together.

units.source_text: 源氏公子不回左大臣邸，

en.t: Prince Genji did not return to the Minister of the Left's residence,

units.source_text: 也不回二条院私邸，

en.t: nor did he go back to his private residence at Nijo,

units.source_text: 在途中和头中将分手了。

en.t: but parted from To no Chujo along the way.

units.source_text: 头中将觉得奇怪，

en.t: To no Chujo found this strange,

units.source_text: 心想：“他到哪里去呢？”

en.t: and wondered to himself, "Where is he going?"

units.source_text: 他自己原要去和一个情妇幽会，

en.t: He himself had originally meant to go meet a lover in secret,

units.source_text: 此时暂且不去，

en.t: but for the moment he put that aside,

units.source_text: 却跟在源氏公子后面，

en.t: and instead followed behind Prince Genji,

units.source_text: 窥察他的行踪。

en.t: secretly watching where he went.

units.source_text: 头中将骑着一匹全无装饰的驽马，

en.t: To no Chujo was riding a plain, completely undecorated nag,

units.source_text: 穿着一身家常便服，

en.t: and was dressed in ordinary informal clothes,

units.source_text: 所以源氏公子不曾注意他。

en.t: so Prince Genji never noticed him.

units.source_text: 他看见源氏公子走进了这个意想不到的地方，

en.t: When he saw Prince Genji enter this unexpected place,

units.source_text: 心里更觉奇怪。

en.t: he felt even more puzzled.

units.source_text: 忽然里面发出琴声，

en.t: Suddenly the sound of a koto came from within,

units.source_text: 他便站着倾听。

en.t: so he stood there and listened closely.

units.source_text: 他料想源氏公子不久会出来的，

en.t: He expected that Prince Genji would come out before long,

units.source_text: 所以一心站在那里等候。

en.t: so he stood there waiting with all his attention fixed on it.
